localChanges: In a big game, every message about one of your cities, and every update after a move, carried the whole map you had explored along with it. So the start of a turn could hang for several seconds, with the map flickering, the old turn still showing and keypresses ignored. Those messages now carry only what they're about. On a turn-265 save, one message went from 2 MB to 44 KB, and the updates for a whole turn from about 5 MB to 1.6 MB (#130).
